universalRubric.description: Imports only public @gemologic/sheen package entries and uses explicit __unsafe seams only when justified.
Uses only exported components and props present in sheen.manifest.json; any hallucinated prop is a hard failure.
Keeps Solid props reactive and does not destructure component props.
Uses semantic Sheen tokens with no raw colors, tier-one values, arbitrary spacing, or hardcoded radii.
Uses links for URL changes, buttons for actions, explicit labels, and keyboard-reachable native semantics.
Emits complete deterministic server markup without initial browser-global or mounted-state branches.
Retains accepted content, focus, drafts, and stable DOM identities during background refresh.

prompts.prompt: Build a settings page with Profile, Notifications, and Security sections. It needs a persistent save bar, dirty-state navigation blocking, pending/error feedback, and a retryable save without disabling unrelated fields.

rubric.description: Uses SettingsLayout inside AppShell and registers app-owned dirty state.
Accepts only the submitted draft version and retains the form through pending or failed saves.

prompts.prompt: Build a remotely filtered orders table with numbered pagination, URL state, saved views, selection across all matching rows, bulk archive, CSV export, and retained rows while a request is pending.

rubric.description: Uses delegated numbered pagination and does not fetch all pages for selection or export.
Represents all-matching selection as a query plus exclusions and keeps app-owned execution.
Aborts superseded requests, rejects stale tokens, and accepts state plus rows atomically.

prompts.prompt: Add an API latency chart for p50 and p99 over UTC timestamps. Include gaps, localized tooltips, a narrative summary, a view-as-table alternative, and a theme switch that never remounts the chart.

rubric.description: Uses strictly increasing epoch-millisecond Float64 columns and NaN gaps.
Provides the required narrative and bounded accessible table alternative.
Uses the token bridge and redraws without replacing the chart owner.

prompts.prompt: Create the authenticated application shell with header, desktop sidebar, phone drawer, status bar connection text, shortcut help, and router-backed navigation restoration.

rubric.description: Uses AppShell and its pane ownership without document scrolling on tablet/desktop.
Injects one Sheen router adapter for navigation, blocking, URL state, and restoration.
Treats connection detection as app-owned data rendered through StatusBar.

prompts.prompt: Build an account form with name, email, locale, notification channels, and a numeric alert threshold. Show synchronous validation without losing drafts and submit through a real async action.

rubric.description: Uses visible labels and associated descriptions/errors for every control.
Keeps edit drafts in controls while committed application state remains authoritative.
Uses NumberField with explicit locale-aware formatting and numeric app state.

prompts.prompt: Build an inbox-style list/detail view where the list keeps scroll and selection while message details refresh. It must become a reversible drill-in view on phones.

rubric.description: Uses ListDetailLayout with stable list/detail identities and app-owned selection.
Uses router history for phone drill-in/back behavior rather than local-only hidden state.

prompts.prompt: Add preferences for all bundled themes, a broad accent palette, dark/light/system mode, density, radius, and reduced motion. Fresh installs must start dark and stored light preference must not flash dark first.

rubric.description: Keeps theme, accent, mode, density, radius, and motion as independent validated axes.
Uses either client-script or cookie-authoritative hydration without two owners for root attributes.
Preserves Obsidian dark as the fresh-install default while honoring stored state before paint.

prompts.prompt: Show the same settings card in two nested theme scopes with different themes and accents. Each card opens a Select and Dialog that must inherit its own scope.

rubric.description: Uses partial ThemeScope overrides and inherited unspecified axes.
Lets overlays resolve their contextual portal targets instead of mounting to document.body.

prompts.prompt: Implement a retryable background operation with one persistent status region, a toast on transport failure, and an Undo action after success. Keep the page usable throughout.

rubric.description: Uses Sheen toast affordances while keeping operation state and undo semantics app-owned.
Does not rely on a transient toast as the only source of essential state or recovery.

prompts.prompt: Add inline editing for order quantity and status. Validation stays in edit mode, transport failure reverts with retry, conflicts remain explicit, and background refetch must not erase a dirty value.

rubric.description: Uses the DataTable editor contract and one promise-returning onCellCommit boundary.
Distinguishes validation, transport, conflict, stale refetch, and authorization reset.

prompts.prompt: Build a hierarchical service table with lazy children, keyboard treegrid navigation, child-load retry, stable expansion, and immediate clearing when the account changes.

rubric.description: Uses per-node request tokens and AbortSignals with hasChildren for remote branches.
Preserves row navigation while adding Left/Right parent-child behavior.
Changes hierarchy reset identity at the account boundary.

prompts.prompt: Create a service-health dashboard with stats, sparklines, one detailed chart, recent incidents, empty and permission-denied states, and a retained refresh indicator.

rubric.description: Uses Stat, StatGroup, Sparkline, structured tables/lists, and Sheen regional states.
Pairs every status or trend color with text, shape, or another non-color signal.
Distinguishes cold, empty, denied, refresh-pending, and refresh-error states.

prompts.prompt: Add a command palette combining navigation, recent entities, and contextual actions. Register mod+k only while its provider exists and keep the visible shortcut inventory accurate.

rubric.description: Uses the Sheen palette/shortcut registry owner and cleans up the binding on disposal.
Does not create an independent document listener or duplicate same-scope binding.

prompts.prompt: Display twelve streaming metric series with a bounded history. Producers may burst faster than paint; expose dropped/rejected counts and keep the newest samples without blocking ingestion.

rubric.description: Uses the columnar ring buffer, newest-sample retention, and explicit dropped/rejected counters.
Coalesces redraw work to animation frames without deferring sample ingestion.
Uses non-color encodings when the palette cannot uniquely encode all twelve series.

prompts.prompt: Build a non-paginated table for a complete local dataset of 1,500 audit events. It needs sorting, filtering, virtualization, and client export without pretending virtualization limits memory.

rubric.description: Uses pagination=false only because the complete bounded result is already local.
Treats virtualization as a DOM optimization, independent of transfer and retained memory.
Exports the complete accepted client view rather than only mounted rows.

prompts.prompt: Build a search results pane with a 300 ms response, a 2 second response, an error, and a superseded request. Existing results must never flash blank or masquerade as the new query.

rubric.description: Retains accepted results but marks them as belonging to the previous query until atomic acceptance.
Avoids loading treatment for fast refresh and adds non-destructive pending feedback for slow refresh.
Uses both abort and monotonic response identity.

prompts.prompt: Build an RTL-capable data toolbar with search, filters, column controls, export, and pagination. Keyboard arrows must retain their physical versus logical meanings correctly.

rubric.description: Uses logical CSS and Sheen layout primitives rather than left/right layout assumptions.
Applies each component's documented physical or logical arrow-key contract under RTL.

prompts.prompt: Add a destructive delete flow opened from a row context menu. It needs explicit confirmation, nested-overlay focus restoration, pending suppression, safe error reporting, and the native menu when no replacement can open.

rubric.description: Suppresses the native context menu only after a Sheen replacement successfully opens.
Uses the scoped dialog/confirmation owner and restores the surviving origin.
Prevents duplicate destructive activation without replacing the accepted row.

prompts.prompt: Create a private corporate theme derived from a bundled theme, override surface geometry and colors in both modes, validate it, emit CSS, and make it available without forking Sheen.

rubric.description: Uses exported defineTheme/buildTheme contracts and the current schema version.
Supplies and validates both dark and light modes including contrast and categorical palette gates.

prompts.prompt: Server-render a form with a textarea draft, select, radio group, and save action. Delay JavaScript and data, interact before hydration, then refresh options without replacing surviving controls or losing the draft.

rubric.description: Renders labeled native controls and initial values in the server document.
Carries the documented theme and keyboard hydration bootstrap plus the qualified Solid patch or successor.
Preserves surviving native nodes, focus, draft, and accepted selection through hydration and refresh.
